text:
rachel: Quick huddle: perf regress last night forces a small launch trim. Proposal: MVP=conversation surface + embeddings + billing hooks. Move tenant-aware routing, admin dashboards, and historical exports to v1. Also suggest postponing the UX polish pass to post-launch. Thoughts?

omar: Agree on keeping billing hooks. UX polish is just visual; cutting it saves ~3 dev days. Tenant routing is the risky oneit affects routing tables and gateways.

casey: Infra: tenant routing increases gateway memory and adds an extra queue. If we cut it we reduce p95 variance and avoid spinning another gateway node. We can support a 2-customer pilot with manual routing if Sales needs it.

nia: Ops ask: if we cut dashboards, we must provide a read-only support endpoint plus a compact diagnostic bundle for SRE. Low effort if feature-flagged; I'll scope the doc.

derrick: Sales note: two enterprise prospects expected dashboards and per-tenant routing. If we delay, offer a pilot and an ETA for v1 within 3 sprints. They'll accept a pilot if we lock an SLA for onboarding.

rachel: Guardrail: lock cuts now if canary 6h median < 150ms and p95 < 210ms. If metrics exceed that, we cancel launch and plan a one-week delay. Also keep auth & billing hooks non-negotiable.

omar: I'll prepare a soft-flag for tenant routing so we can flip it per-customer if needed. ETA: PR tonight.

casey: I'll author rollback steps and an automated alert for memory/queue depth: runbook: `ops runbook -> disable-tenant-flag.sh` then restart gateway, smoke tests. Target recovery < 20m.

nia: I'll update release notes: explain trimmed items and v1 recovery plan. Draft line: "Deferred: tenant-aware routing, admin dashboards, long-term exports; recovering in v1 (approx 2 sprints)."

derrick: I'll collect the prospect list and request pilot exceptions only for strategic accounts.

ops-bot: staging deploy scheduled: branch `release/2026-07-10` -> staging at 2026-07-08 02:00 UTC. Monitoring started.

rachel: Action items recap: 1) @omar implement soft-flag + PR, 2) @casey add rollback script & alerts, 3) @nia update comms + support bundle, 4) @derrick collect pilot requests. I'll lock scope by 16:00 if canary metrics hold.

omar: PR opened `github.com/redwood/release/pull/910` with notes for QA.

casey: Rollback script added to repo and alert runbook published.

rachel: Locking scope: core conversation + embeddings + billing hooks; deferring tenant routing, dashboards, exports, and polish to v1. Posting update to handbook now.
